title: VerySimpleLogin
description: VerySimpleLogin is a simple plugin made for personal servers to stop people from joining on other peoples accounts
body:
Tried of Players ask you to ban someone because they logged on their account? WELL NO MORE SHALL YOU LISTEN TO THEM COMPLAIN FOR THIS PLUGIN HAS COME TO SAVE YOU!

VerySimpleLogin stops people from joining on other peoples accounts, see a simple login with password is NOT ENOUGH, because there is a chance of them guess your password or if your server does not have a login area or spawn place PEOPLE CAN STEAL YOUR BASES CORDS 😲. So to stop this, Very Simple Login just compares the Ip of the device the player first joined on vs the Ip of the device they ARE joining from.
